scope.rule: Replace the exact leading agent-folder root prefix only. Preserve every suffix byte-for-byte, including nested URL, snapshot, RAW, history, and filename segments.

merge_policy.path_absent_at_target: Move source entry under target prefix, preserving exact mode and content object.
merge_policy.same_path_same_mode_same_blob: Deduplicate the identical entry and record both source and target provenance.
merge_policy.same_path_different_mode_or_blob: Preserve both versions under conflicts/<literal-relative-path>/<source-or-target>--<mode>--<git-object-id>, with a manifest of original paths, modes, and object IDs. Never overwrite, choose by timestamp, or resolve with an LLM/manual guess.
merge_policy.directories: Merge recursively by literal child name; apply the same collision policy at each child path. Do not normalize suffixes.

known_current_metadata_references.action: Update only as a live repository locator after the merge.
Update only as a live repository locator after the merge.
Historical inventory is pinned by snapshot_commit; retain this path spelling, commit, and counts.
Historical example path: retain its old spelling and resolve it against the pinned commit; do not float it to the merged tree.
Historical example paths: retain old spellings and resolve against the pinned commit; preserve all blob/SHA values.
Live locator prefix may change; preserve all suffix segments literally.

historical_and_external_references.pinned_history: References to the accepted base or older commits retain the historical path spelling and exact commit; do not float them to the current branch.
historical_and_external_references.external_urls_and_templates: GitHub URLs, API paths, and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE are outside this agent-folder-root mapping and remain unchanged.
